name: 98110 · Bainbridge Is, WA
findings: ZIP 98110 (Bainbridge Is) has 168 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98110 (Bainbridge Is) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98110 (Bainbridge Is) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
